name: replit
description: The Replit interface for the mod protocol — a two-way bridge between a fleet module and a Repl, and an MCP server over the mods that live on Replit. LINK registers a deployed Repl as a remote and null-calls it to cache the mod it serves, every function and every parameter; CATALOG is that index — the mods running on Replit — and `call` reaches any function on any of them. MCP (mcp.py, stdio or POST /mcp on this same port) exposes the whole bridge as tools plus one typed tool per function per linked Repl (repl_{remote}_{fn}), so an agent calls the Repl-hosted mods directly instead of driving this module. BUNDLE goes the other way: any fleet module becomes a Replit-runnable project (.replit, replit.nix, a stdlib main.py that reproduces the mod URL rule) as a zip or a one-click Run-on-Replit URL. DB browses Replit's key-value store over your own REPLIT_DB_URL, kept off-chain in ~/.mod/replit. IMPORT scaffolds a new orbit module from the GitHub repo behind a Repl. Replit ships no public API (GraphQL is persisted-query-only, exports are 403) — this module bridges what is actually reachable and says so where it isn't.
